verdict.rationale: Stable's own API documents searching for and retrieving MailItems. Each MailItem object exposes scanDetails with an imageUrl, OCR result URLs and a summary, so an operator can programmatically pull scans and mail metadata off the platform. However, nothing documents a dedicated bulk export, archive download or account-exit data dump. Missing for 10: documented bulk/one-click export of all scans and mail history, explicit PDF export format, offboarding/data-portability guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
